questions.stem: Passage: "Sleep is not a waste of time. While we sleep, the brain sorts the information it received during the day and stores the important parts. Students who stay up all night before an exam often do worse, not better, because their memory has no chance to consolidate what they studied. Doctors suggest that young adults get seven to nine hours of sleep. A short nap of twenty minutes can also help, but a long nap in the late afternoon may make it harder to fall asleep at night." **In a summary, how should 'Doctors suggest that young adults get seven to nine hours of sleep' be written?**
options: Young adults must sleep exactly eight hours.
Doctors do not know how much sleep people need.
Doctors themselves sleep seven to nine hours.
Young adults are advised to sleep seven to nine hours.
